new.statement: Young games launching with more than about 55 developer products hold lower Top Trending positions among games of similar age
new.action: Launch with a lean product list

new.statement: Young games that put weapons or combat tools in players' hands hold higher Top Trending positions among games of similar age
Games from verified creators rank higher on Up-and-Coming among games of the same age
Regional folk-horror franchises (the Malay/Indonesian MALAM SAMA series, Arabic ghost stories) keep landing new entries on Up-and-Coming within two weeks of launch, even with weak like ratios
new.action: Localize horror for an underserved region
new.rationale: Renews the auto-retired H-x-032 on fresh evidence: MALAM SAMA OPAH still ranks #5 on Up-and-Coming at 19 days and a sequel-style MALAM SAMA ATOK (10 days, 53% likes, Malay-language jumpscare products) entered Up-and-Coming at #56 today. Confirm if a third regional entry lands within two weeks or ATOK climbs into the top half; refute if both drop off within three weeks.

new.statement: Anime fighting RPGs that sell rerolls of race, clan, grimoire or appearance (Shibuya, Ishin, Clover Adventure, Cloverlines) reach Top Earning within one to five months on modest player counts
new.rationale: Four young anime RPGs profiled today sit on Top Earning (#115 to #472) with reroll products as the core store (Shibuya race/clan rerolls up to 4,500 R$, Ishin 125 rerolls at 3-5 R$, Clover Adventure and Cloverlines grimoire/clan spins). RPG genre already earns more per player (H-te-011, 92%). Confirm if more reroll-led RPGs enter Top Earning in the top half of efficiency; refute if they sit below the RPG median.

new.statement: Asymmetric two-role co-op, where one player sees and the other acts (Backseat Rally's blind driver and navigator), can carry a game onto Most Popular and Top Earning within five weeks
new.rationale: Successor to the retired H-x-015: Backseat Rally (34 days, 72.5M visits, 91% likes) sits on Most Popular #34 and Top Earning #183 while selling cars and crates. One game so far; confirm if another two-role co-op game reaches Most Popular, refute if Backseat Rally falls off both charts within three weeks.

qualitative_updates.note: Three more ragdoll sandboxes entered Up-and-Coming today (Ragdoll Verity Sandbox, Realistic Ragdoll Physics, Untitled Ragdoll Game), Ragdoll titles are 14% of Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll Physics rose 37 on Most Popular and leads Up-and-Coming, Ragdoll Research is #2; Ragdoll Wars (-41) and Realistic Ragdoll Playground (fell off) show individual entries fade.
DONT SPLASH holds #3 on Most Popular and #4 on Up-and-Coming at 22 days, and DONT SWIM rose 21 on Top Trending at 14 days.

Four Halloween-tagged titles left Top Earning today (Run a Hotel, REDLINER, Peroxide, Dig For Eggs), while King Legacy rose 154 on a fresh update and Fish It! is running a 'final week' Halloween finale.

Fake an Egg -13 on Most Popular, Steal Eggs From Tsunami -13 on Top Trending and Detect and Steal an Egg -30 on Up-and-Coming, while Steal An Egg stays #1 on Most Popular; Climb and Steal an Egg is a new Top Trending entry, so new clones still appear.

Steal-and-defend loops (r=-0.62) and physics sandboxes (r=-0.70) remain the weakest Top Earning loops while both lead Up-and-Coming and Most Popular risers; Ragdoll Physics is #1 on Up-and-Coming and among the four least efficient earners.
Top Earning efficiency runs from the 28th median percentile at 15-42 days to the 62nd past a year, while Up-and-Coming's 0-14 day games hold the 73rd percentile.
uc->tt rose to 206 entries (median 2 days) and tt->mp to 167 (2 days); tt->uc stays at 1.
Ice Cream Shop [Anomaly] fell 15 on Top Trending and 31 on Up-and-Coming, and Clone Baby Care (Anomaly) left Up-and-Coming; the Anomaly format is losing breakout ground this week.
Two more games show the hourglass NOW icon today, Anime Fighting Simulator (Update 13) and Dream Car Collection (UPD 4), both on Top Earning; still a convention, not yet a measurable effect.
